pillar_reactions.evidence: Delivered in a well-tailored form — the rep tied it to the knees ('especially when you have those knee issues with the ACL being rebuilt and the damage in the other knee, definitely those two muscle groups need strengthening'), to the sitting-related back pain, and to overtraining risk at 70. The prospect said 'Wonderful' and then, when pressed with 'You sure?', raised the one thing that should have been treated as a warning: 'I have seen your videos and have used them to some degree... A little worried on some of them, I locked myself out with a kettle ball because of, you know, swinging it around.' He also confirmed he had already bought one kettlebell. The rep answered with the first-month form-check process rather than with the concern.

He asked a direct compatibility question about his existing protocol: 'are you going to make suggestions regarding my nutrition or are you guys also in a bottle of keto type diet? I mean, carbs are out.' The rep answered that Trevor's approach leans keto-ward and is whole-food based, and flagged protein intake for recovery as the likely adjustment. Accepted without further question. Not addressed by either party: the keto protocol is the same one he credits with normalising his PSA, so changing it is not a neutral nutritional decision for this prospect.

'Any thoughts on that? That sounds good.' No questions and no engagement. The weekly check-in was pitched partly as an injury guard, which is the right emphasis for him — 'if something needs adjusting he will know and he will do that on the go' — but he did not react to it.

anchors.raw: I would have to say I would be more, do something about the $500 I can't, I'm on Social Security and I'm taking care of my family still. So I have three daughters, three daughters, and I have a large property here, and I do make some income, but I have to be responsible with that too.
anchors.note: Not an anchor in the usual sense but the hardest number on any call in this batch. A stated ceiling around $500 against $6,000 is a structural mismatch, not a negotiating position — there is no payment structure that closes a twelve-fold gap on a fixed income. He also said he would need the price 'about half that amount' to be possible, which still leaves $3,000 well beyond the ceiling he named in the same breath.

anchors.raw: I didn't think it would be cheap, but I wasn't prepared for that, Andrew.
anchors.note: He arrived with no price information at all and said so explicitly — 'See, I didn't know what your fees were, and I'm sorry to put you through this to find out.' A prospect on a fixed income reached a full pitch and a $6,000 reveal without any price pre-frame anywhere in the funnel. That is a setter and marketing finding as much as a closer one.

anchors.raw: I have seen your videos and have used them to some degree... I only purchased one kettle ball, but I guess we'll start with whatever he said.
anchors.note: Third call in this batch where the prospect is already self-serving from the free content and the paid product is never differentiated from it. Here it is sharper than usual, because his one attempt at self-directed practice hurt him — which is the single best available argument for paying for supervision, and it was not made.

anchors.raw: my family does have some longevity abilities. My grandmother lives up to 95
anchors.note: He supplied this himself and the rep used it well, converting it into the twenty-five-years-remaining frame that produced the deepest agreement on the call. The strongest supporting anchor available and the one piece of value-building that genuinely worked.

anchors.raw: It'll be in, it'll be in November and December. November is the qualification... and then December is the state
anchors.note: A hard external deadline five months out that maps almost exactly onto the six-month programme, which the rep spotted and used: 'We have July, August, September, October, and some November, which is almost five months. That's enough time.' Urgency was never the problem on this call.

anchors.raw: we have a local lady here called Dr. Boz... she's in Tampa, and she's a keto proponent, and it's been beneficial. To my health, I've lost 10 pounds in at least the last, you know, six months.
anchors.note: He follows and pays attention to a named health authority and has assembled his own treatment protocols, so he is not resistant to investing effort or money in health per se. The constraint is scale, not willingness.

unmet_demand.want: A senior or reduced-price tier, which he requested explicitly and unprompted
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He asked for it in as many words while paying the deposit — 'maybe Trevor should consider when people are at my, maybe, you know, senior plan' — and was told 'I'll let him know.' No lower-priced option was offered at any point on the call. The 07/06 sales team meeting confirms that a $200 per month Primal University tier exists and that the manager instructs reps to route unaffordable prospects into it: 'Yeah, just get them into Primal U. Just explain that to them.' That route was available and was not used, so a fixed-income prospect with a real goal and a real deadline left with nothing he could buy.

unmet_demand.want: Training that is safe to prescribe alongside an unresolved prostate cancer question, a declined biopsy and an ongoing self-administered protocol
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Nobody in the transaction is qualified to answer it and nobody asked. The prospect disclosed the position unprompted; the rep moved to the next question. Whether loaded ballistic training is appropriate for this man before his September urological review is unknown, unasked and unanswerable by a salesperson. Flagged for a human.

unmet_demand.want: Programming that loads a reconstructed ACL and a damaged meniscus safely at 70 while avoiding the overtraining that hospitalised him before last year's qualification
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep promised it directly — 'definitely those two muscle groups need strengthening, yeah? So that's going to be addressed specifically in the program' — plus bespoke mobility protocols for the knees and lower back. The commitment was made in the room; no clinician was involved and no evidence exists on the call that the programme has a rehabilitation capability behind it.

unmet_demand.want: Sport-specific periodisation toward a competitive swim meet, including a taper into the November qualification
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep described exactly this — 'the whole program, it's going to be a structured progression and Trevor will know your goal. So towards the end, towards the November, the volume is probably going to be a little bit lower' — and it is a specific, checkable claim about competitive swim preparation. Nothing on the call establishes whether the programme does sport-specific periodisation or has ever prepared an athlete for a meet.
